subject.title: fix(grep): bound file reads with size cap in default grep operations

question: Should default grep context intentionally omit content from regular files above a fixed 50 MiB limit, and what user-visible degraded result should be the supported contract?
rationale: The PR changes a previously unlimited default path for existing workspaces; the chosen ceiling and how unavailable context is presented are compatibility behavior rather than a purely mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Adopt a documented bounded-context default
options.body: Keep a fixed cap, implement it as a hard byte-bounded read, and make oversized-file context reliably unavailable without risking process memory.

options.title: Choose a different compatibility contract
options.body: Retain more existing large-file context behavior through another explicitly approved limit or presentation policy, then implement and test that contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt a documented bounded-context default
recommendation.body: Keep a fixed cap, implement it as a hard byte-bounded read, and make oversized-file context reliably unavailable without risking process memory.
